purpose: Canonical-form registry. One entry per quantity that has more than one valid representation in this project. The numbers gate refuses any manuscript value not traceable to a declared canonical form.
why_this_exists: Four separate instances of one-concept-two-representations have appeared here (bus identifiers, boundary-mass definition, M1 vs M2 curve, seed-mean vs count-pooled aggregation). That is a systemic property of the repo, not four coincidences. Twice, a careful reader reasoned from a planning document rather than an artifact and reached the wrong conclusion.

schema.network: REQUIRED on every entry. A network-free entry is invalid. The +1 bus offset is a property of case118's ordering, not a general fact.
schema.representations: every form the quantity appears in
schema.conversion_site: file:line where conversion happens, or null if none is needed
